title: Shelter A fills up
description: Evacuees arrive at Shelter A until it is full. An alert fires when utilization reaches the configured threshold (SHELTER_ALERT_THRESHOLD, default 0.85).

steps.note: 84%: just below the threshold, no alert.
Full: new evacuees must be directed to the nearest shelter with capacity.

expected: At 200/200 the shelter shows available 0 and plans route evacuees to the nearest shelter with capacity
